Detailed Description

Interpolated oscillator class.

With this class you can perform table-driven synthesis of any kind.

Constructor & Destructor Documentation

LoopOscillator::LoopOscillator ( SoundInfo *  info,
SignalTable *  tab,
double  amp = 1,
double  freq = 440,
double  phi = 0 
)

Class constructor.

You must provide the pointer to an object of type SignalTable and the pointer to an object of type SoundInfo. In this way this class implements the Subject - Observer pattern. It is the Observer. By default, it plays the table at 440 Hz, with maximum amplitude (1).

void LoopOscillator::update ( Subject *  s  )  [virtual]

It recalculates the table increment factor by dividing the SignalTable length with the main sampling rate.
